import java.io.*;
import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        new Main().process();
    }

    void process() {
        FastScanner scanner = new FastScanner(System.in);
        FastWriter writer = new FastWriter(System.out);
        
        int n = scanner.nextInt();
        int m = scanner.nextInt();
        int s = scanner.nextInt() - 1;
        long t = scanner.nextLong();
        
        GTakeMetro solver = new GTakeMetro();
        int result = solver.run(n, m, s, t);
        writer.println(result + 1);
        writer.flush();
    }

    static class GTakeMetro {
        int run(int n, int m, int s, long t) {
            long[] lastSeen = new long[n];
            Arrays.fill(lastSeen, -1);
            int[] stationSequence = new int[n + 1];
            int seqLen = 0;
            
            while (t > 0) {
                if (lastSeen[s] != -1) {
                    long cycleStart = lastSeen[s];
                    long cycleLength = cycleStart - t;
                    
                    if (cycleLength > 0) {
                        long remaining = t % cycleLength;
                        while (t > remaining) {
                            t--;
                            s = step(n, m, s);
                        }
                    }
                    break;
                }
                
                lastSeen[s] = t;
                stationSequence[seqLen++] = s;
                s = step(n, m, s);
                t--;
            }
            
            while (t > 0) {
                s = step(n, m, s);
                t--;
            }
            
            return s;
        }
        
        int step(int n, int m, int s) {
            int sign = s < m ? 1 : -1;
            s += sign;
            s %= n;
            if (s < 0) s += n;
            return s;
        }
    }

    static class FastScanner {
        BufferedReader reader;
        StringTokenizer tokenizer;

        public FastScanner(InputStream stream) {
            reader = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(stream), 32768);
            tokenizer = null;
        }

        public String next() {
            while (tokenizer == null || !tokenizer.hasMoreTokens()) {
                try {
                    tokenizer = new StringTokenizer(reader.readLine(), " \t\n\r\f,");
                } catch (IOException e) {
                    throw new RuntimeException(e);
                }
            }
            return tokenizer.nextToken();
        }

        public int nextInt() {
            return Integer.parseInt(next());
        }

        public long nextLong() {
            return Long.parseLong(next());
        }
    }

    static class FastWriter {
        PrintWriter writer;

        public FastWriter(OutputStream stream) {
            writer = new PrintWriter(stream);
        }

        public void println(int value) {
            writer.println(value);
        }

        public void flush() {
            writer.flush();
        }
    }
}
